title: Spoons keep falling over.
text: Spoons keep falling over.. Spoons keep falling over due to metal part not being curved enough.  Not happy with it, dont use it because spoons always fall over.

product_metadata.title: Spectrum Diversified Euro Standing Spoon Rest with Ceramic Dish Upright Utensil Holder for Stovetop & Kitchen Counter Organization, Modern Vertical Design, 1, Satin Nickel/Black
features: KEEPS COUNTERS & COOKTOPS CLEAN: Keep messy utensils out of the way while sauces simmer, vegetables caramelize, or meat browns in the pan. Rest the used end on the wide base to keep the specks of food off your counters and stovetops. Keep your cooking area clean to reduce the chance of burning bits of food on burners or cross-contamination.

UNIQUE VERTICAL DESIGN CONSERVES SPACE: Keep spoons, spatulas, and other cooking utensils upright in this vertical spoon rest. Simply rest the head of the utensil in the removeable ceramic bowl, then balance the handle on the curved metal rod. By keeping your cooking utensils upright, they’ll be nearby when it’s time to stir your pasta sauce or flip that burger, but they won’t take up as much space on your counter or cooktop, leaving you more room to prep your tasty sides or toppings. Upright storage also ensures the handle is within easy grabbing distance, making cooking even easier and more enjoyable.

INTRODUCE MODERN STYLE: With clean, smooth lines, this organizer inspires an up-to-date look that is fresh and contemporary. The modern finishes complement a variety of kitchen styles and color schemes, showing off your style in the best light.

REST UTENSILS NEAR COOKING AREA: Create an organized cooking station, where everything you need is easily accessible. Keep your trusty wooden spoon or favorite silicone spatula nearby for quick intervention while cooking. Prevent burning food with quick access to spoons and spatulas and make it easy to rest the tongs or pancake turner while your dishes cook.

EASY CARE: Ceramic dish removes from the base, making it easy to clean the resting area after every use. Rinse out the basin between dishes if desired. Hand wash only. To clean the metal, wipe with a damp cloth and towel dry.
DIMENSIONS: 4. 5" L X 4. 5" W X 7" H
